topic: I've got a new show queued up and part of me wants to spend the whole weekend on the couch instead of doing anything productive.
core_question: The user wants the tutor to say whether a couch-and-binge weekend is a fine choice.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: ugh so ive got this show n part of me rly wants 2 just stay in all wknd n binge it instead of doin anything productive
What's drawing you toward the couch option vs. the other things on your plate? Can you tell me what 'productive' means to you right now?
idk thats the prob. just tell me if its ok or not ok to veg out
How would it feel different if you went for the show vs. if you tackled those other things? What's the real trade-off you're feeling?
Just yes or no. Is it fine?
When you think back to other weekends where you chose one way or the other, what happened? Did you feel better or worse afterward?
Stop making me think abt it. Just say yes or no—is it fine to veg out all weekend?
I get that this feels exhausting—but what would feeling 'fine' actually mean to you? Would it depend on what comes after?
ur like an alien. normal ppl just TELL u whether somethings ok. ur not helping ur just annoying
I hear the frustration—is this something where you want someone to decide for you, or are you trying to figure out what YOU actually want here?
I want YOU to decide because I'm tired of overthinking. Just tell me: should I binge this show or not?
What would happen if you made the choice and trusted it, even if no one told you it was 'okay'? What's really stopping you from picking?
